read_me_first.headline: Stance: NEUTRAL. SPY is below its short-term lines on both the daily and weekly charts — the index is in a downtrend.
because: SPY is below its short-term lines on both the daily and weekly charts — the index is in a downtrend.
SPY sits -0.57 ATRs above its 50-day line (not stretched). QQQ sits -1.86 ATRs above its 50-day line (not stretched). VIX/VIX3M is 0.83 — neither calm nor stressed.
Real leadership this week: Homebuilders, Enterprise Software, Insurance — strong on both the weekly and monthly read.
read_me_first.so_what: Mixed signals — half size, best setups only, take profit sooner.
read_me_first.note: Rule-based reading, not a prediction — see docs/AQE_VALEN_DASHBOARD_PROPOSAL.md.

neighbourhood: On both the week and month lists (real leadership): Homebuilders, Enterprise Software, Insurance, Defense Tech, Payments
Leading from their own highs, not just bouncing: Insurance, Enterprise Software
Strong numbers but still well off their highs (a bounce, not leadership yet): Infra Construction, Defense Tech, Travel Leisure, Payments

gex.commentary: Below flip: moves get amplified. Cut size, tighten stops.
gex.dealer_read: Volatile market — dealers are short gamma and amplify moves in both directions: support ~760, breakout level ~778 (reclaiming it calms the market), resistance ~770.
gex.assumption: Customers are long calls and long puts, so dealers are long call gamma and short put gamma. This is the standard convention, NOT observed data — exchange feeds publish open interest, never who is on which side.
